assets.name: sasha-avatar
assets.description: Square flat editorial bowl character on pale lime. Soft mint bowl, dark pine linework and calm face, dark green and lime leaves, tomato and wheat. Clear centered silhouette, no text or unnecessary accessories.
assets.prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: final raster brand avatar for Mealset, an adult-oriented nutrition companion named Sasha; square canvas, 1024 x 1024 or larger.
Input images: Image 1 is the redesign reference. Preserve its recognizable mint food-bowl character and lime-to-mint color family while radically simplifying the busy drawing.
Primary request: Redesign the supplied avatar into an exceptionally simple, confident editorial illustration that reads perfectly at 40 pixels. A grown-up friendly food companion: wide soft mint bowl, two small calm dark pine eyes and a gently asymmetric little smile. Above the bowl, exactly four bold food silhouettes: one dark green leaf, one lime green leaf, one small tomato accent, one wheat/golden shape. Make the leaves broad and the grain shape simple enough to remain legible at tiny scale.
Style/medium: flat-color illustration, intentional dark pine outlines of consistent medium weight, almost screen-printed craftsmanship. Beautifully balanced silhouette, minimal internal detail, warm personality without babyish exaggeration.
Composition/framing: central character occupies approximately 68 percent of square width; spacious, balanced negative space around it; safe for a circular crop. Solid pale lime background edge-to-edge, no circle border, no frame.
Color palette: pale lime background, soft mint bowl, dark pine outline and face, deep green and vivid lime leaves, small natural tomato-red and wheat-gold accents.
Constraints: one final image, no text, no typography, no badges, no logo wordmark. Preserve recognizability as an evolution of the reference, not a literal copy.
Avoid: hat, arms, hands, gloves, magnifying glass, tech circuits, sparkles, gradients, huge kawaii eyes, cheek blush, 3D, plastic, generic robot, photorealistic person, complex salad detail, glossy highlights, extra food objects, drop shadow.

assets.name: mealset-food-hero
assets.description: Landscape editorial still life of salmon, pearl grains, broccoli, tomato and cucumber in a mint ceramic bowl on a cool white tabletop, with cut lime and two loose green leaves. Natural light from the left, bowl center-right.
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: final landing-page hero photograph for Mealset nutrition companion, landscape 3:2 image, at least 1536 x 1024.
Primary request: An art-directed, very natural editorial still life of a wide low mint ceramic bowl containing a simple genuinely appetizing meal: roasted salmon, pearl grains, vivid crunchy green vegetables, tomato, and cucumber.
Scene/backdrop: cool off-white studio tabletop close to #f7f9f5, with a cut lime and a few loose fresh leaves beside the bowl. Sparse deliberate arrangement, every object resting naturally on the tabletop.
Composition/framing: bowl at center-right, slightly elevated three-quarter camera view, generous calm negative space around it and especially to the left, complete bowl visible with comfortable margins. Sophisticated international food-magazine composition suitable for a premium restrained landing page.
Lighting/mood: soft daylight from the left, long gentle actual shadow, true natural colors and subtle tonal range. Fresh, quiet, inviting.
Materials/textures: sharp tactile food textures, natural irregularities, salmon with delicately roasted surface, distinct pearled grains, crisp vegetables, ceramic with a soft matt glaze, realistic physical surfaces.
Color palette: restrained white, pine green, vivid lime, and soft mint, supported by natural salmon and tomato colors.
Constraints: one final photograph. No lettering, no interface, no devices, no people, no utensils, no extra props, nothing floating, no branding, no watermark.
Avoid: plastic CGI, artificial perfection, fake sparkles, over-saturated color, dramatic dark backdrop, glossy stock-photo styling, artificial compositing.
